# twingatetunnel_http_proxy (Ephemeral Resource)

Starts the Twingate Client in HTTP proxy mode and returns the proxy URL. Use it for providers with an explicit proxy setting, such as `kubernetes { proxy_url = ... }`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `probe_destination` (String) Optional `host:port` of a Twingate Resource. The proxy is ready once the client reports Online and, when this is set, a probe tunnel to it stays open.
- `ready_timeout` (String) How long to wait for the proxy to be ready, as a Go duration. Defaults to `90s`.

### Read-Only

- `proxy_host` (String) Proxy listen address.
- `proxy_port` (Number) Proxy listen port.
- `proxy_url` (String) Proxy URL, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:41234`.
